per_candidate.id: s2:Counting the Unseen. II. Tidal Disruption Event Rates in Nearby Galaxies with REPTiDE

rationale: The papers 'The Delay Time Distribution of Tidal Disruption Events' (2604.04831), 'An Explanation for Overrepresentation of Tidal Disruption Events in Post-starburst Galaxies' (2311.07040), and 'Tidal Disruption Event Demographics in Supermassive Black Hole Binaries Over Cosmic Times' (2507.08082) provide new insights into TDE rates and their dependence on various factors, contributing evidence relevant to the discrepancies in TDE rates and the inferred black hole masses.
